senses.gloss: (v. טוּל I), Pa. טַלֵּיל, Af. אַטְלֵיל to play, sport, Succ. 53ᵃ לוי הוה מְטַלֵּל וכ׳ Ar. (ed. מְטַיֵּיל, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 200) L. was sporting … with eight knives.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 91b:5">B. Bath. 91ᵇ</cite> <he>נהירנא</he> … <he>מְטַלְּלִין וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מטיילין</he>, Var. <he>מְטַלִּין</he> or <he>מַטְּלִין</he>, <he>מְטַלְּיָין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) I remember that boys and girls enjoyed themselves &c.
